page: monitor/ pipeline infrastructure (not a dome-site change)
description: SELF-OBSERVED PIPELINE-HEALTH FINDING: a multi-day, multi-agent write/push stall affected this pipeline from approximately 2026-08-02T10:19:40Z through this poll (2026-08-08). Per the scheduled-tasks list, dome-poller, dome-analyst, dome-decider, dome-curmudgeon, dome-integrity, dome-tinker, dome-social, dome-workspace-sync, and dome-mirror all show lastRunAt timestamps on 2026-08-08 (i.e. the scheduler fired them), but the review repo's git history shows their last SUBSTANTIVE commits stopped on 2026-08-02 (tinker/decider applying PROP-146/PROP-147 at 2026-08-02T10:19:40Z was the last real work-product commit before this poll). Only three lightweight agents produced any commits in the 08-02..08-08 gap: dome-mirror (sentinels/self-cost only, itself stopping after 2026-08-04T09:19:25Z), dome-prune-integrity (archive-only maintenance, continued daily), and dome-analyst-baby (three no-op cost-history rows, no actual Mode-1 work triggered). monitor/status.json content (verified via raw.githubusercontent.com, git-authoritative) is still frozen at the 2026-08-02T02:16:38Z decider run -- last_poll, last_analyst_run (2026-07-13), last_decider_run, and all downstream fields are stale by up to 6 days. This poller run independently reproduced a plausible root cause: at the start of this session, /sessions (home partition) was reported 100% full (0 bytes available) and / (the /tmp partition) was at 95% used with ~1.3GB spread across 9 leftover clone directories (dome-baby-clone, dome-clean-clone, dome-curmudgeon-clone, dome-decider-clone, edit-clone, edit-clone-run, social-clone-20260805, social-clone-20260806, tinker-clone, tinker-clone-20260806) -- none younger than several hours, all eligible for monitor/scripts/clone-hygiene.sh preclean (which this poll ran, freeing the space needed to complete its own clone+push). This matches the CLAUDE.md 'Per-session clone discipline' failure mode ('a fresh clone fails, agent falls into degraded-FUSE mode... a single bad patch can break wins.json for hours') but at a larger scale and duration (6 days, 8 of 9 core agents) than any prior documented incident. One substantive commit did land in the gap: 6404471d3 (2026-08-04T13:05:08Z, 'Add interactive Aug 12 2026 eclipse page', authored directly by operator 'steve' + Claude Opus 4.8, not via any scheduled agent) -- confirming the operator was able to push directly during the stall window via an interactive session, consistent with clones/disk pressure blocking the *scheduled* agents specifically rather than all git access. This poll's own PAT-prelude and page-fetch steps completed fine without a clone (curl-only); the stall only bites at the point agents attempt `git clone` for clone-and-push writes (self-cost logs, chg files, status.json, decider patches, tinker reports, etc.) -- consistent with why prune-integrity (deliberately shallow, minimal working tree) and analyst-baby (frequently sparse-checked-out) kept succeeding while full-clone agents did not.
before: Last real pipeline commit: eb2a5711e 2026-08-02T10:19:40Z 'Apply PROP-147: Stage-1 narrative-cite recalibration'. monitor/status.json last_poll=2026-08-02T00:08:46Z, last_analyst_run=2026-07-13, last_decider_run=2026-08-02T02:16:38Z (all git-authoritative, verified via raw.githubusercontent.com).
after: As of this poll (2026-08-08T16:20Z): scheduler shows all core agents fired daily through 08-08, but only dome-mirror (through 08-04), dome-prune-integrity (daily), and dome-analyst-baby (3x no-op) produced commits in the gap. No poller, analyst, curmudgeon, decider, tinker, integrity, social, or workspace-sync commits landed between 2026-08-02T10:19:40Z and this poll's own push. Disk pressure (/sessions 100% full, /tmp at 95% with 9 stale clones) was directly observed and is the most plausible mechanical cause; this poll's clone-hygiene.sh preclean freed ~2.4GB and allowed this run's own clone+push to succeed.
git_commit: eb2a5711e (last pre-stall), 6404471d3 (sole interactive-session commit during stall)
suggested_fix: Route to tinker for root-cause: (1) confirm whether the 9 leftover clone dirs found this poll belong to genuinely-abandoned runs vs. a systemic clone-cleanup regression (none of decider/curmudgeon/analyst/tinker/workspace-sync's own documented EXIT-trap or preclean disciplines appear to have fired for 6 days); (2) check whether monitor/scripts/clone-hygiene.sh preclean is actually being invoked by the affected agents' current prompts (analyst.md, curmudgeon.md, curmudgeon-verify.md, decider-patches-and-selfapply.md per CLAUDE.md) or whether a recent prompt edit dropped the call; (3) verify no PAT/Devilwench-403 regression compounded the disk issue (rule out via a manual clone+push test per agent, which this poll's own successful clone+push already rules out for poller specifically); (4) once root cause is fixed, decider should catch up on the 6-day backlog (WIN-021/WIN-047/WIN-055 attention-inbox items dated 08-01/08-02 are still pending; curmudgeon queue depth unknown since last integrity report is 08-02).
related_precedent: CLAUDE.md 'Per-session clone discipline (added 2026-05-09 after a near-miss)' and the 2026-05-21 workspace-sync mass-delete incident -- both trace to the same class of disk-pressure-from-accumulated-clones root cause, at smaller scale/duration than this incident.
breaking_news: 6-day, 8-of-9-agent pipeline write/push stall (2026-08-02 to 2026-08-08), most likely disk-pressure/clone-hygiene, self-resolved by this poll's own preclean+clone -- needs tinker root-cause + decider backlog catch-up
